Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Scheduled for elective thoracotomy
  -  ASA status 1,2
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Inability to provide adequate informed consent
  -  Any contraindication to the placement of thoracic paravertebral catheters
  -  Unstable vertebral  [OR] and transverse process fractures
  -  Any chronic painful conditions  [OR] or preoperative opioid use Any chronic painful conditions  [OR] or preoperative opioid use
  -  Coagulation abnormalities  [OR] or expectation to be on therapeutic anticoagulants postoperatively
  -  Allergy to any of the drugs/ [OR] agents used in study protocol
  -  Altered mental status  [OR] or emergency surgery
  -  Comorbid conditions such as sepsis, unstable angina, [OR]  congestive heart failure
